text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (When did I start hearing these voices?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Why did I start comparing her race record
whenever I put together my rotation?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(—To trample over everything. To paint it all over.
Yeah, that's right. Isn't that right?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(I won't accept that guy. There's no way
she could ever be Symboli Rudolf—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hate to interrupt while you're in the zone,
but shouldn't you be heading out soon? Kyoto, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa—Sirius Symboli's
roommate, and an Umamusume who loves to gamble.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...
...Tch, what time is it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Look at the time. You seem awfully relaxed
for someone about to run the final leg of the Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm off. Thanks for the help.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it.
What am I even doing?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Today is the Kikuka Sho. I don't have time
to be distracted by her, so why—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli clutched her head
in her hands all alone.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah!
...So this is what they call an "obsession," huh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(My mind won't stop racing like an idiot.
I just can't stop thinking.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...Fine, I'll admit it.
I am obsessed with "Symboli Rudolf".)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(That's why she was obsessed with trampling them...
That's why I kept hearing her voice...!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Still, even if that were true—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(The reason I won't do a 'direct showdown'
is because she's not worth my time.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(I don't feel any loneliness seeing him change.
No fear facing it, and no trite desire
to turn back the clock—there's no way in hell.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll see for myself.
And that'll be the end of everything."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka-sho.
Sirius Symboli was late meeting up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We managed to get in touch, but they said they'd arrive right at the wire.
Did some kind of trouble happen, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"—In a recent press conference, mentions were made
regarding Symboli Rudolf's racing schedule for this year."

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"First is the 'Japan Cup' next month,
and if all goes smoothly, she also has her sights set
on the 'Arima Kinen' afterwards—"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Will they bring the year to a thrilling close once again?
Expectations are running high!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Half-listening to the TV I'd turned on for background noise,
I waited restlessly for her arrival. When suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Sorry I'm late.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' at all. ...You're just yappin'
and worryin' way too damn much.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Get my racing silks ready.
Once I change, I'll go do a light warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly casts her eyes downward.
...No matter how you look at it, something definitely happened.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —I told you there's nothing, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Keep your mouth shut,
and just sit there behaving yourself while you wait.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(I'll prove it.
To myself. And most of all, to this worrywart nature of mine—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(I'll move my piece "next."
First I'll seize this... and move on to the "next"!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the Kikuka Sho got underway.
